reader_summary.overview: Australian James Aitken is the Founder and Managing Partner of Aitken Advisors, a one-man macroeconomic consultancy based in Wimbledon. James started his career in 1992 as a foreign exchange trader, moved to London in May 1999. In August 2006 he joined UBS.
